svg.title: 3 RPC tiers. The spare can veto.
svg.desc: Failover v0.7.0 on Alpenglow. The holder steps down on its own local signals: a stalled slot, silent RPC, votes not landing or no network. A verified hung holder can be hard-stopped by its daemon. The spare observes independently. Local RPC detects delinquency using seven of ten readings. The spare checks the preferred external RPC, falls back to public RPC when necessary, then checks its own local view again. Missing evidence or a local veto holds the handoff. After 300 seconds from first local delinquency, an unresolved hold can alert the operator. By default the operator performs a warm swap after an alert. An armed spare can take cold in live mode after its readiness check. After a successful handoff, verify that the standby is voting. The return to the primary is manual. The holder’s 30-second self-fence threshold, standby’s 60-second delay and optional backup’s 120-second preset are independent.
